{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel
print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment']))

# Check if channel distribution is confounded by customer_segment
# This is critical: email was targeted at returning and loyal customers
# So the higher revenue in email may be due to segment, not channel

# Compute average revenue per customer in each channel
channel_avg_revenue = sales_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("\nAverage revenue per order by channel:")
print(channel_avg_revenue)

# Compute total revenue by channel and customer_segment
revenue_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum()
print("\nRevenue by channel and customer_segment:")
print(revenue_by_channel_segment)"}
